about-creator-bio: Passionate software engineer focused on building clean, maintainable, and scalable enterprise web solutions with modern PHP, Laravel, and frontend technologies.
about-desc: REPALOGIC Dashboard is a modern and robust enterprise application foundation platform built on top of Laravel 11, PHP 8.2+, Spatie RBAC, and Inspinia Admin Bootstrap 5. Featuring multi-tier authentication workflows, smart access control matrix, social user profile & instant messaging, 2FA TOTP security, comprehensive activity logs, modular bilingual engine (EN/ID), and integrated self-maintenance utilities.
about-mod1-desc: Controlled registration workflow (admin approval), account reactivation request, idle auto lock-screen, and friendly CSRF 419 token guard.
about-mod2-desc: Hierarchical role & user permission matrix tables, superadmin protection, smart permission deduplication, and instant cache invalidation.
about-mod2-title: Access Control Matrix & Spatie RBAC Governance
about-mod3-desc: Role-based adaptive views (admin vs user), user status counters, database backup health monitor, and interactive 7-day activity charts.
about-mod4-desc: Comprehensive citizen ID/residence records, 1:1 avatar cropper (Cropper.js), drag-to-reposition cover banner, blur effects, & color tint overlay.
about-mod4-title: User Profile Ecosystem & WYSIWYG Cover Customizer
about-mod5-desc: Friendship requests, profile likes, instant messaging with audio voice notes, file attachments, pinned messages, and unsend capabilities.
about-mod5-title: Social Networking, Friendship & Instant Messaging Hub
about-mod6-desc: RFC 6238 TOTP two-factor security (Google Authenticator/Authy), offline SVG QR code renderer, and 8 encrypted recovery codes.
about-mod7-desc: Model-level activity logs with side-by-side diffs, forensic login tracking (IP, OS, browser, device), and automated log retention pruning.
about-mod7-title: Centralized Activity Audit Trail & Forensic Login Logs
about-mod8-desc: Instant zero-reload bilingual switching (< 5ms) powered by 6 isolated domain JSON dictionaries and anti-flicker pre-hydration.
about-mod9-desc: 3-level menu structure (Main Menu, Sub-Menu, Child Sub-Menu) with Tabler icon picker, route generator, and Spatie permission binding.
about-mod10-desc: Dynamic feature flags, scheduled database backups (.sql/.gz), orphan image scanner & cleaner, symlink repair, and 1-click cache flush.
about-mod10-title: System Self-Maintenance Center & Database Backup Engine
